reviewCriteria: Odori meeting: photo is directional clue only; current-location share does not permit fence crossing; wait outside fence without obstructing, send board/path photo and await reply.
Clock Tower: historical overview materials conditional on availability, photography remains permission-dependent, use term/heading notes without touching exhibits.
TV tower: friend fears window proximity more than lift, waiting area and return route unconfirmed before ascent, consult friend and staff, meet here if learner goes alone.

Hospital reception: right wrist pain after yesterday fall, fingertip numbness since this morning and perceived worsening; receptionist cannot diagnose or guarantee admission, notes precede work concerns, staff assess referral/appointment/documents.

Police wallet hand-in: twenty minutes is approximate, crossing-side location shown by finder, contents/cards untouched and unphotographed, officer explains finder rights/contact sharing before learner records preferences; no promise of private number protection is invented.

Factory shoe purchase: protective toe cap plus slip-resistant soles, 26cm is learner requirement not stock confirmation; mall tenancy/contact listing conditional, ask company if supplier unavailable, do not buy on appearance alone.

Vegetable shelf labels: 100g unit price differs from 300g bag, neighboring origin differs, actual bag price/weight checked before checkout, learner waits with one bag and chooses count after verification; no amount invented.

Ramen seating: two adjacent seats and suitcase storage remain unconfirmed, keep aisle/entry clear, order only after arrangements, assist friend reading menu and check adjustability per dish, do not promise non-spicy modification.

Hypothetical izakaya: colleague arrival unconfirmed and may cancel; learner ultimately enters as two, third seat not held, 300yen/person and 600yen/two plus food/drink, single payer; fees are simulation terms not real-store policy certification.

Cooler loan return: lid/box present but original strap at home; deadline day after tomorrow, return tomorrow with original strap and slip, compare IDs/condition, take box back today, deposit settlement conditional on slip not guaranteed refund.

Commuter shoes: waterproof differs from slip resistance; no ice guarantee; current foot slides downhill, compare fastening/shape and heel/toe room with thick winter socks before choosing, increasing size not automatic fix.

Bowling beginners: both wear socks, right rental shoe toe area tight only, game not started; ask practice/turn handling, both wait, never enter lane for unreturned ball, staff explain safe range before start.

Salary bank: ask full bank name/existing-account acceptance/payroll deadline; only residence card plus employer information confirmed, sufficiency pending; screening and same-day completion unpromised, ask before signing.

Missing bicycle update: supermarket manager moved bicycle to storage, blurry silver/black-basket photo is candidate only, number later matches registration, tomorrow collection distinct from location confirmation today; ask handler about follow-up without inventing withdrawal procedure.

Postal missed delivery: address match alone does not identify addressee; husband named, same household does not ensure counter collection, check requirements/storage deadline/available delivery slots, keep husband recipient separate from requester contact field.

Payroll bank branch: apparent example branch not confirmed requirement, ask employer first; residence card updated while phone bill old address; disclose discrepancy, ask required/missing documents list, application acceptance does not establish account opened.

Fish-free soup: vegetable-stock name not proof of ingredients, bonito extract is fish-derived, only fish avoidance currently stated; same-factory warning separate from ingredients, extent of avoidance not inferred allergy/religion, manufacturer clarification and store photo rules remain pending.

Fog walk: mapped path is out-and-back not loop, 20minute intention revised to turn around after about10minutes, no distant viewpoint, stay within sign visibility and unaided-return range, end early if conditions worsen; invented park routing not real-world route claim.

Fictional Kitami train search: reverse direction and last-week date corrected; penultimate20:10,last21:05,no transfer;19:40finish+20minwalk=20:00arrival,10min buffer; candidates not guaranteed service, seek employer ride if delayed rather than run.

Post-employment health-insurance consultation: old job ended last month, new job started but insurance procedure/start unconfirmed; bring eligibility-loss document and separate exit/loss/joining dates, request consultation not immediate enrollment; no gap/overlap inference.

External prescription: receipt differs from prescription, second sheet in bag; one designated pharmacy is mistaken assumption, check accepting pharmacy and preparation/validity before after-work visit; pharmacist/prescriber handles dosing questions, receptionist does not.

Fictional found-keys record K-27: original09:20 photo taken immediately after finding supports about09:20 not exact pickup minute;12:05 is forwarding only, same bus-stop bench location, no new photograph, readback distinguishes evidence and uncertainty.

Mail forwarding: choose present home not copied workplace address, include building/room, list both spouses with differing surnames, yesterday move date distinct from requested start date; same-day activation not guaranteed, identity verification pending.
